status: draft; not submitted; requires Quiver account
title: Kingdom Hearts: Chain of Memories
description: Revisit Castle Oblivion in a native PC port of Kingdom Hearts: Chain of Memories, with widescreen and ultrawide support, optional HD dialogue and menu text, and support for EU, US and Japanese cartridges.
setup: Launch ReKHCoM.exe and select your own unmodified EU, US or Japanese GBA ROM. No ROM is included. Native save import is available in the launcher.
aiDisclosure: Development includes substantial coding-assistant contributions on top of the Pheenoh/khcom decompilation. Select the official AI-use category according to the definitions in the submission form; do not claim no AI use.
validation: Release contents, digest and root launcher checked. Quiver installation/launch has not been tested. This is a field map, not a documented submission API payload.
